verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a one-off capability: running a single job on Hugging Face infrastructure (gh-4). Nothing shows automations that are scheduled, recurring or triggered to run autonomously in the background. Repo webhooks (docs-17) only notify a consumer about repo changes, so they are a building block a developer could use to construct automation rather than an automation feature itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
